none: PAS CAM-807E70: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy Contempoarary Copy of a Roman Radiate Coin, Barbarous Radiate, Copying a Radiate of Victorinus
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy contempoarary copy of a Roman radiate coin, barbarous radiate, copying a radiate of Victorinus, dating to c. AD 275-285 ( Reece period 14 ). Reverse legend reads [INVICTVS]. Reverse shows Sol standing left, star in field. Mint is unknown. See Cunetio p.162, cf.2958. Obverse legend is illegible. Obverse shows Radiate bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: */-//-. Die axis is 6…
